test.title: The return of the town well

paragraphs.text: When the mains arrived in 1952, the town well was covered with a concrete slab and forgotten. Its water had been famous for a hundred years, and carters had sold it in the next valley.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: A dry summer changed minds. With the reservoir low, the council opened the well again and found the water clean, though it now runs more slowly than the old records describe.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: The well is kept as an emergency supply. Two pumps are tested each spring, and a sign explains that the water must be boiled if the town’s taps ever fail.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Some residents want it used every day. Engineers reply that a source used only in emergencies is easier to keep clean than one that is always open.
paragraphs.label: D

document.title: The return of the town well

items.quote: a sign explains that the water must be boiled if the town’s taps ever fail
items.prompt: an instruction for anyone using the water

explanation.en: The water must be boiled — the instruction is in paragraph C.
explanation.kk: Суды қайнату керек — нұсқау C абзацында.
explanation.ru: Воду нужно кипятить — указание в абзаце C.

items.quote: Some residents want it used every day.
items.prompt: a disagreement about how often the source should be used

explanation.en: The disagreement about frequency is in paragraph D.
explanation.kk: Қаншалықты жиі пайдалану туралы дау — D абзацы.
explanation.ru: Спор о частоте использования — абзац D.

items.quote: When the mains arrived in 1952, the town well was covered with a concrete slab
items.prompt: why the well stopped being used

explanation.en: The well was closed when the mains arrived — paragraph A.
explanation.kk: Су құбыры келгенде құдық жабылған — A абзацы.
explanation.ru: С приходом водопровода колодец закрыли — абзац A.

items.prompt: what prompted the town to look at the well again

explanation.en: A dry summer brought the well back into view — paragraph B.
explanation.kk: Құрғақ жаз құдыққа қайта оралуға мәжбүр етті — B абзацы.
explanation.ru: Засушливое лето заставило вернуться к колодцу — абзац B.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Which paragraph contains the following information? Write the correct letter, A–D. NB You may use any letter more than once.
